mechanics.claim: Maokai dashes to the target enemy while being untargetable, dealing damage and rooting them upon arrival.
mechanics.quote: '''Maokai''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy while being {{tip|untargetable}}. Upon arrival, he deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|roots}} them for a duration.

mechanics.claim: The ability fails to deal damage and apply the root if the target is untargetable upon arrival.
mechanics.quote: ''Twisted Advance'' will fail to deal damage and apply the {{tip|root}} if the target is {{tip|untargetable}} upon arrival.
